$comment: Compounder screen definition. v0.2 thresholds (the midpoint of the v0.1 draft and the relaxed set, chosen after the first US run: 21 names in band vs 7 / 38). Every number here is an opinion until compounder/backtest says otherwise. See compounder/SCREEN.md for the reasoning behind each line. Units: US money in USD millions, India money in INR crore; percentages as numbers (15 = 15%).

roce.name: Return on capital employed
roce.rule: at least 4 of the last 5 fiscal years >= 12, and no year below 8

grossMargin.name: Gross margin holding or widening
grossMargin.rule: latest fiscal-year gross margin >= (5-year high - 3 points)
grossMargin.rankOn: latest gross margin minus 5-year-ago gross margin, descending

growthWithoutDilution.name: Revenue growth without printing shares
growthWithoutDilution.formula: revenue CAGR over 5 fiscal years; diluted weighted-average share count change over the same 5 years
growthWithoutDilution.rule: revenue CAGR >= 10 and share count up <= 10; a share count that FALLS more than 60% over 5 years is treated as a data fault (unit change in the filing) and the trait as not applicable; rises are real dilution and fail
growthWithoutDilution.rankOn: revenue CAGR minus share-count CAGR, descending

cashConversion.name: Cash earnings back reported earnings
cashConversion.formula: sum of operating cash flow over 3 fiscal years / sum of net income over the same 3 years (sums, not an average of ratios, so one near-zero year cannot blow it up)
cashConversion.rankOn: ratio, descending, capped at 3.0 for ranking

leverage.name: Little debt
leverage.formula: (total debt - cash and equivalents) / (EBIT + depreciation and amortisation), latest fiscal year
leverage.rule: net debt / EBITDA <= 2, or net cash (negative net debt passes)
leverage.rankOn: net debt / EBITDA, ascending (net cash ranks first)

composite.$comment: A company must pass all five rules to be on the quality list. Among passers, rank on each trait's rankOn field, sum the five ranks, lowest sum wins. No weights: weights would be fitted to the past. Failures are reported per trait ('fails on debt') so the dashboard can show why.

exclusions.$comment: Gross margin and ROCE are meaningless for balance-sheet businesses. These are excluded rather than given their own rules for v0.1.

us.note: banks, insurers, brokers, REITs, holding and investment companies

in.note: names from data/sectors.json / engine.js sector map

us.name: United States
us.universe: all EDGAR filers with a common stock listing on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American that file 10-K (excludes 20-F / 40-F foreign filers for v0.1)

fundamentals.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts API
fundamentals.pointInTime: use the 'filed' date on each fact; a fiscal year's numbers become usable the day the 10-K was filed

prices.source: Yahoo Finance chart API, adjusted closes (scripts/compounder-prices-us.mjs)

momentumIndex.name: Russell 2000
momentumIndex.note: small/mid universe, so the gate uses a small/mid index, not the S&P 500

in.name: India
in.universe: NIFTY 500 constituents plus any NSE main-board name inside the cap band with 5 fiscal years of data

fundamentals.source: TBD: Screener.in Premium quarterly download (manual) or EODHD fundamentals (API) — decision pending a one-week trial
fundamentals.pointInTime: NOT available: data is as-restated. Usable-from date is approximated as fiscal year end + 60 days (SEBI annual results deadline). The dashboard and backtest must label Indian results 'restated data, look-ahead bias possible'.

momentumIndex.name: NIFTY 50
momentumIndex.note: data/history/ carries only NIFTY 50 today; switch to NIFTY MIDCAP 150 once the history has it

momentumOverlay.$comment: Reuses momentum.js rankAt() on the quality list. Same parameters as the desk's momentum engine so the two can never disagree about what 'moving' means.
momentumOverlay.intersectionRule: on the quality list AND momentum-eligible AND momentum rank within the top half of the quality list AND gate open

pointInTime.$comment: What the screen may know on a given date. The backtest and the live run use the same rule.
pointInTime.us: a fact is visible from its EDGAR 'filed' date
pointInTime.in: a fiscal year's facts are visible from fiscal year end + 60 days

backtest.rebalance: quarterly, on the first trading day of Jan / Apr / Jul / Oct
backtest.holdingPeriod: 12 months, overlapping cohorts (each quarter's portfolio tracked for a year)
report: mean and median 12-month excess return per cohort
share of cohorts where top decile beats bottom decile
max drawdown of the rolling portfolio
robustness: every threshold shifted by +/- 20% one at a time

passCriteria.$comment: Written down before the run so the result cannot move the goalposts.
passCriteria.topBeatsBottom: top decile beats bottom decile in at least 70% of cohorts
passCriteria.topBeatsIndex: top decile mean excess return > 0 AND median excess return > 0
passCriteria.robust: no single +/- 20% threshold shift flips topBeatsBottom to false

survivorship.us: universe rebuilt each quarter from filers active at that date (EDGAR submissions index)
survivorship.in: hand-built historical NIFTY 500 membership list (data/universe-in/YYYY-QN.json), pending

history.0.1.0: ROCE 15 in 4/5 floor 10; GM within 2 pts; CAGR 12. First US run 2026-10-25: 19 pass, 7 in band.
history.0.2.0: ROCE 12 in 4/5 floor 8; GM within 3 pts; CAGR 10. Same run: 45 pass, 21 in band.
